title: 2.4 Was ist das?
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Things, Numbers and Colors
unit_outcome: Name places and things with their articles, count them, and say their color and size.
goal: Ask what something is with Was ist das? and answer with Das ist ein/eine.
grammar_function: Was ist das? Das ist ein/eine + noun; wer is for people.
speaking_outcome: Ask what something is and answer.
